x, y, n = map(int, input().split())
numerator, denominator = 0, 1

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    lower_bound = (i * x) // y
    upper_bound = lower_bound + 1

    def evaluate(val, idx):
        nonlocal numerator, denominator
        diff1 = abs((denominator * y) * ((x * idx) - (y * val)))
        diff2 = abs((y * idx) * ((denominator * x) - (numerator * y)))
        if diff1 < diff2 or (diff1 == diff2 and idx < denominator):
            denominator = idx
            numerator = val

    evaluate(lower_bound, i)
    evaluate(upper_bound, i)

print(f"{numerator}/{denominator}")
